free_tier.stated: No free tier. Cheapest paid offer: VPS-1, 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 16 GB SSD, 900 Mbit/s shared port, 1 TB traffic, KVM, in Germany (Falkenstein), USD 1.81 per month, which is USD 0.0025 per hour; the monthly figure is the hourly rate over 730 hours. Servers are billed by the hour from a prepaid USD balance, with no setup fee and no minimum term, and prices exclude VAT.
free_tier.notes: VPS-2 is 1 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 32 GB SSD and 32 TB traffic at USD 3.54 per month; the unmetered n1.micro is 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 32 GB SSD and a 50 Mbit/s guaranteed port at USD 29.20 per month; dedicated servers show out of stock

retention.stated: a server is billed by the hour until it is deleted; the vendor's billing wiki covers suspension after the balance runs out, and the suspension period was not read
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost on deletion is the running process and its disk, not a stored object

egress.terms: VPS-1 includes 1 TB of traffic on a 900 Mbit/s shared port; traffic beyond a plan's included limit costs USD 2.00 per TB; unmetered plans exist from USD 29.20 per month with a guaranteed port instead of a shared one
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB on VPS-1 (the period is not stated on the pricing page)

interface_detail: REST API at https://cloud.datapasa.com/api described by an OpenAPI document at https://datapasa.com/openapi.json; SSH access and a VMmanager panel are listed in the vendor's server-management wiki; the plans table states a VNC console on all plans
tooling: bearer-token REST API: POST /api/auth/login returns a 15-minute access token and a 30-day refresh token; no API keys or OAuth are issued; /api/public/catalog lists locations, plans and USD prices without credentials; authenticated endpoints other than /api/me answer 403 FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED until a device check is completed in the control panel
chaining: A German KVM box that is created and deleted through a documented REST API and billed by the hour from a USD 5 minimum balance, with cryptocurrency top-ups accepted, fits short-lived workers and proxies; the 32 TB traffic plans start at USD 3.54 per month.

limits.value: 1 TB of traffic included on VPS-1; USD 2.00 per TB beyond the plan limit
900 Mbit/s shared port on VPS-1; the unmetered plans guarantee 50, 100 or 250 Mbit/s
16 GB of SSD on VPS-1; 32 GB on VPS-2

limits_note: Registration is limited to 10 attempts per hour per IP address and login to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per email and IP address.
binding_note: 1 TB of included traffic on the cheapest plan is smaller than the 32 TB on the next plan up, so traffic is the limit that binds before disk or port speed.

identity_cost.detail: Registration takes first name, last name, email, password and an accepted-terms flag; the request has no phone or identity-document field. A verified email address is required before ordering. The prepaid USD balance is topped up from USD 5 by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through Stripe, PayPal, PIX, or about 100 cryptocurrencies, so no card is needed. Authenticated API calls other than /api/me return 403 FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED until a device check is completed in the control panel.

reliability_note: unverified: no outage history was read; the site states a 99.9% uptime SLA.
confidence_note: Price, shape, location, top-up rules and registration fields come from first-party pages read on 2026-10-28; the browser sign-up page returned no text, so the registration fields rest on the vendor's auth.md. A measured read needs one provisioned server.
